description: The plot illustrates the memory usage in gigabytes (GB) as a function of the number of frames processed by different video understanding models. The x-axis represents the number of frames, ranging from 0 to 1000, and the y-axis represents the memory usage in GB, ranging from 0 to 400. The plot includes five lines, each representing a different model: VideoLLaMB-R (red), VideoLLaVA (yellow), PLLaVA (green), LLaVA-NeXT (blue), and VideoLLAVA (purple). The VideoLLaMB-R line shows a steep increase in memory usage as the number of frames increases, reaching approximately 400 GB at 1000 frames. The VideoLLaVA line also shows a steep increase, reaching around 350 GB at 1000 frames. The PLLaVA line shows a more gradual increase, reaching about 100 GB at 1000 frames. The LLaVA-NeXT line shows a moderate increase, reaching around 150 GB at 1000 frames. The VideoLLAVA line shows a steep increase, reaching approximately 300 GB at 1000 frames.
